content.title: 动名词(-ing)作宾语和表语 速查
content.intro: 动名词(动词 + ing)兼具动词和名词的性质,可作宾语(动词宾语 / 介词宾语)和表语。判断口诀:某些动词与所有介词后,跟动作要用动名词(doing),不用不定式(to do)或原形。

rows: enjoy/finish/mind/avoid/keep/practise/suggest/consider/imagine/can't help + doing:She enjoys learning body language.
介词(at/in/of/for/about/on/to)+ doing:be good at reading faces;look forward to learning
be + doing,说明主语内容:My job is teaching. / Seeing is believing.
want/hope/decide/plan/would like + to do(这些动词后用不定式,不用动名词)

specialRules.rule: look forward to / be(get) used to / instead of 里的 to 是介词,后接动名词
specialRules.mark: look forward to seeing(× to see)
avoid making the gesture(× to make)

specialRules.rule: 动名词作表语 ≈ 主语内容的等价说明,主表常可互换
specialRules.mark: My job is teaching = Teaching is my job

specialRules.rule: 区分:be doing 作表语(说明主语) vs be doing 作进行时(强调动作正在进行)
specialRules.mark: His hobby is fishing(表语)/ He is fishing now(进行时)

why: 介词是"接名词性成分"的词,而动名词正是动词的名词形式,所以介词后、以及部分及物动词后,要把动作变成 doing 才能作宾语;作表语时,动名词同样以名词身份说明主语"是什么/做什么"。
gaokaoPoints: 高频考点:enjoy/avoid/mind/finish/suggest/consider/practise/keep/can't help + doing 的固定搭配。
易错点:look forward to / be used to / instead of / devote…to 里的 to 是介词,后接 doing,不是动词原形;语法填空与改错高频。

examVsReal.exam: I look forward to hearing from you.（考试/书面）
examVsReal.real: Can't wait to hear from you!
examVsReal.note: 考试用 look forward to + doing;口语常换成 can't wait to do

examVsReal.exam: My job is teaching English.（表语,考试标准）
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考动名词作表语;口语里直接用动词更自然
